content: The execution was successful with a reward of 1.0. The strategy of reconstructing paragraph text from multiple `<hp:t>` elements and redistributing the replaced text into the first node while clearing subsequent ones is effective for HWPX files. This approach handles the common issue where placeholders are fragmented into separate XML nodes during document editing. Removing `<hp:lineSegArray>` from modified paragraphs ensures the HWP viewer recalculates layout correctly. Future tasks involving HWPX or Office Open XML should continue to use this 'reconstruct-replace-redistribute' pattern rather than simple regex on raw XML.
